name: ComparaSoftware

sources.title: ComparaSoftware — live LatAm software review/comparison platform (Mexico HQ; country sites across LATAM + Spain); 'Registrarse en ComparaSoftware es gratuito'; 'Regístrate como Fabricante' → /panel-usuario/register, partner registration at /panel-usuario/partner-register

requirements: Free vendor registration — 'Regístrate como Fabricante' (Register as a Manufacturer) at /panel-usuario/register
Spanish-language, Latin-American audience — Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Brazil, Colombia, Spain, etc.
Vendor perks listed: reach potential users, collect reviews, position vs. competitors, verify the product
The platform itself is free for users because vendors pay per lead contact — so paid lead-gen options exist behind the free listing
preparation: Product description in Spanish ideally, category fit within their software taxonomy
Pricing/feature details for the comparison engine
workflow: Create the product profile with features/pricing
Product appears in category listings and the comparison tool; user reviews accrue over time
watchFor: LatAm/Spanish market — a product without Spanish support has weak fit
Lead-gen economics — advisors refer buyers to vendors who pay per contact; expect sales outreach
countsAsLive: The product has a profile page and appears in ComparaSoftware category listings
